comment: Single source of truth for the Fast / Balanced / Maximum quality presets. scripts/build_workflows.py writes these values into the apps. Maximum equals the official Comfy-Org template defaults (the validated upstream ceiling); Fast and Balanced only reduce memory/time drivers and are measured in docs/QUALITY.md.

documentation.cascade_resolution: Trellis2UpsampleStage.target_resolution - voxel resolution of the refined shape. Upstream default 1536; Pixal3D's own low-VRAM mode uses 1024.
documentation.remesh_resolution: RemeshMesh.resolution - voxel grid of the clean-up remesh. Upstream default 768.
documentation.max_faces: DecimateMesh.target_face_count - polygon budget of the exported mesh. Upstream default 700000.
documentation.texture_size: UnwrapMesh.resolution and BakeTextureFromVoxel.texture_size - base colour / metallic / roughness atlas. Upstream default 4096.
documentation.intents: Game asset caps the polygon budget at 30000 triangles and the texture at 2048 px; normal and ambient-occlusion maps are still baked from the full-detail mesh before decimation. 3D-print optimization is deliberately not offered: ComfyUI Core cannot guarantee a watertight, printable mesh (upstream issue #16147).

intents.comment: Output intent only changes post-processing (decimation and texture size), so switching it re-uses the generated geometry from ComfyUI's cache. High fidelity applies no cap. A cap lowers a value, it never raises it.

routing.comment: Subject routing (docs/CHARACTER_ROUTING_DECISION.md). Auto picks Character bust when MediaPipe finds a face (score >= face_score_min) that is at least bust_min_face_fraction of the picture height AND either RT-DETR finds a person (score >= person_score_min) or the face fills at least portrait_face_fraction of the height (a close portrait). A face without a person is usually a toy, doll or statue, and a small face means a full-length figure: both stay Object, with a note. The bust cut keeps rows 0 .. face_top + bust_cut_face_heights * face_height of the original picture. Under Auto it is applied only when it makes the subject at least bust_min_gain times larger in the model's input (the model sees a square crop of the subject's box, so cutting a tall picture helps and cutting a square one does not), and never when it would remove less than the bottom (1 - bust_cut_max_fraction) of the picture. Choosing Character bust yourself cuts whenever a face box exists.
